questions.question: In deep-submicron ASIC physical design, what is the primary operational role of inserting decoupling capacitor (decap) cells into empty sites of standard-cell rows?
options: To function as local charge reservoirs near switching logic gates, supplying transient current during simultaneous switching to mitigate dynamic voltage droop.
To isolate high-voltage power domains from low-voltage core domains, preventing catastrophic gate oxide breakdown.
To collect antenna-induced charges during plasma etching processes, preventing permanent damage to input transistor gate oxides.
To terminate unused inputs of logic cells to stable VDD or VSS potentials without direct connections to global power rails.
To balance capacitive loading between complementary clock tree branches, reducing clock skew across the die.

questions.question: During sequential logic optimization in digital IC synthesis, what is the fundamental operation performed by 'retiming'?
options: Converting dual-edge triggered flip-flops into single-edge latches to reduce clock distribution network power dissipation.
Relocating flip-flops across combinational logic boundaries to balance path delays and minimize cycle time while preserving external latency and functionality.
Swapping standard logic cells between nominal-Vt and high-Vt threshold libraries to eliminate static subthreshold leakage currents.
Inserting non-inverting delay buffers into short data paths to prevent hold-time violations across process corners.
Grouping asynchronous control signals into synchronous clock domains using multi-stage synchronizing flip-flop chains.

questions.question: In modern computer memory subsystems, how does an 'Open-Page' row buffer management policy in a DRAM controller operate compared to a 'Closed-Page' policy?
options: It powers down unused memory ranks immediately following each access to minimize standby background power.
It splits consecutive memory words across alternating memory channels to maximize peak burst transfer bandwidth.
It keeps an activated DRAM row open in the bank sense amplifiers after an access, optimizing for low latency when subsequent accesses exhibit spatial locality.
It issues an automatic precharge command immediately after each read or write command, optimizing for random access patterns across distinct rows.
It reorders incoming memory requests to ensure that write transactions are always dispatched before read transactions to maximize bus utilization.

questions.question: In modern high-performance processor front-ends, what is the primary architectural purpose of a Return Address Stack (RAS)?
options: To maintain a history of speculative instruction addresses evicted from the L1 instruction cache to prevent frontend pipeline stalls.
To dynamically detect and break circular dependencies among nested function calls during out-of-order execution.
To store the micro-operation dispatch addresses generated by the instruction decoder for complex CISC instructions.
To accurately predict the target return addresses of subroutine and function calls by pushing the return PC on calls and popping it on returns.
To cache the physical memory translations of frequently executed branch targets to bypass the Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB).

questions.question: In digital arithmetic circuit design, how does a Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) fundamentally overcome the linear O(n) latency delay characteristic of a Ripple-Carry Adder (RCA)?
options: By utilizing iterative shift-and-add hardware stages that compute carry bits over multiple synchronized clock cycles.
By precharging internal dynamic intermediate carry nodes during a setup phase and evaluating them in parallel using NMOS logic.
By duplicating adder logic across multiple redundant execution datapaths and selecting the valid sum via multiplexers.
By converting incoming binary operands into redundant signed-digit representations to eliminate carry propagation altogether.
By generating carry-generate and carry-propagate terms across bit positions, enabling the simultaneous calculation of all carry signals through hierarchical logic.
